part.text:
Migrated to App Router. Structure:

- `app/layout.tsx` — root layout with HTML shell and shared metadata  
- `app/page.tsx` — home (from `pages/index.tsx`)  
- `app/about/page.tsx` — about (from `pages/about.tsx`)  
- Removed `pages/` (`_app`, `_document`, etc.)

Build succeeds with `/` and `/about` as static routes.
